description: Hyperliquid market and account data through the Hydromancer API: REST (POST /info) for positions, fills, funding, liquidations, oracle prices, candles, vaults, staking, builder-code fills and HIP-3 / HIP-4 markets; WebSocket streams for trades, fills, liquidations, BBO, L2 and L4 order books with session replay; and Reservoir, a requester-pays S3 archive of historical Hyperliquid data in Parquet. Use when building Hyperliquid trading apps, bots, dashboards, copy-trading, tax tools, backtests or research, or when the task mentions Hyperliquid, HyperCore, HIP-3, HIP-4, builder codes, whale tracking, order book data, liquidations, funding history, wallet trade history, or Hydromancer.
